description: Roberto Aurelio Chávez Arroyo and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The released CFDWind implementation models atmospheric flow for wind-energy assessment within the stated NEWA research setting. Native metadata identifies the public iat-cener/CFDWind repository; repository metadata records C as its principal language and does not provide a detected licence. The deposit terms therefore do not establish a complete software-licensing conclusion. This is an actual flow-modelling implementation. Its documented configurations and evaluation examples do not establish automatic accuracy in every terrain or atmospheric regime. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
